description: This PHP source file defines a class 'registry_v4_1' extending 'registry_v4', responsible for registering web service functions and data types for a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM web service API. It includes method definitions to register functions like 'get_relationships' and 'get_modified_relationships', and to register complex data types used in these services.

classes.name: registry_v4_1
classes.description: A class extending registry_v4 that registers specific web service functions and data types for version 4.1 of the suiteCRM web services API.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers web service functions 'get_relationships' and 'get_modified_relationships' for the API.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in the web services, including 'error_value', 'modified_relationship_entry_list', 'modified_relationship_entry', and 'modified_relationship_result'.
